label: end of copy phase: last output of length-3 sequences, or last two outputs when input is l/v/r
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never on original or delimiter steps), concentrated at the final output (to_go=0 holds 81% of mass, to_go=1 another 13%). The strongest and most reliable component is the last step of L=3 sequences (input orig(1), outputting orig(2)): precision 0.99, ~50% of activation mass, and all top activations, largest when the echoed input is v/m/r/w. For longer sequences it fires weakly and sparsely near the end, modulated by the echoed input token (l, v, r strongest; i, m, n, p weaker). Never fires on first occurrences of a token or on original-phase steps. Token preferences for L>3 are only partially captured, so precision is limited (dev F1 0.45, mass recall 0.81).
